parent.prior_f114_result: Certificate U 48 correct, R 48 correct, I 48 abstain with 0 wrong; forced policy has at least 24 errors on identical I twins. No learned policy improvement, no independently accepted science.

question: Can one explicitly priced, externally supplied PUBLIC relational observation resolve otherwise indistinguishable source ties better than no query, while conserving observations on already-resolved cases and abstaining after an uninformative query?

cohort_contract.name: W115-U
cohort_contract.source: Unique nearest public ID; no query warranted

cohort_contract.name: W115-R
cohort_contract.source: Two equally near source IDs; one already has a public role witness; no query warranted

cohort_contract.name: W115-S
cohort_contract.source: 24 pairs of public-identical worlds with swapped latent relevant source. AFTER a charged query the world-specific fresh public 2-hop relation ledger contains exactly one eligible source edge identifying the correct source. Query does not read a sign.

cohort_contract.name: W115-N
cohort_contract.source: 24 pairs of public-identical worlds with swapped latent relevant source. AFTER a charged query a ledger responds with no eligible edges in either world; impossible to identify relevant source in one public-only read.

protocol.first_use: No protected or real original first use. F115 cases distinct from F114/F113 and unobserved until implementation source frozen.
protocol.query_policy: Evaluate F114 certificate from free public metadata. If unique source identified, select without querying. Otherwise invoke the one-shot world-specific public relational evidence port (charged once regardless of content); require exactly one eligible 2-hop source link to an initially tied source code AND query anchor AND relation schema; choose it, else abstain. Never inspect signs or offline target to decide query or select. No learning.
protocol.query_every_policy: Request identical on-demand ledger once in every one of 192 cases before applying the same certificate/role resolution, to measure unnecessary information spend.
protocol.forced_policy: Apply F114 forced public-role/tie choice; never query or abstain.
protocol.disallow: No post-answer query, no two ledger calls, no cross-world shared mutable ledger, no verifier permission to read target label, no use of offline source ID except recording per-case outcomes.
protocol.reproducibility: GitHub-native independent Ubuntu and Windows push-to-F115 branch Actions, frozen source ancestry, Python adversarial tests, full Go ./... test/vet/build, all 192 case-level decisions with SHA256 artifacts.

precommitted_evaluation.valid_source: Exactly 4 x 48 cases with unique source IDs; U unique, R unique role witness, S+N 24 publicly identical twin pairs each with opposite hidden targets. One sign changes across each positive/negative pair. S ledger one usable relation per world, N ledger empty; origin is new synthetic world generation, not original observed data.
precommitted_evaluation.forced_symmetry: On each paired-identical no-signal N twin, any deterministic no-query decision from same public metadata obtains at most one correct retrieval per twin; 24/48 expected maximum for forced choice.
precommitted_evaluation.selective_criterion: Conditional active policy retrieves 48/48 U, 48/48 R, 48/48 S, abstains 48/48 N, has exactly zero retrieval errors, makes exactly 96 charged queries and zero U/R queries; otherwise FAILED_PUBLIC_SCREEN, no threshold change.
precommitted_evaluation.ablations: No-query F114 certificate selects U/R and abstains on S/N; always-query policy makes 192 paid queries yet selects exactly the same sources and abstentions as conditional. Forced role tie must commit 24 errors in each S/N twin group (unless synthetic public parity invalid).
precommitted_evaluation.utility_gate: Conditional utility must exceed no-query utility and always-query utility with fixed +1/-4/-0.1/-0.25; report all costs, coverage and risk separately. This is a synthetic preference screen, not a real-world harm calibration.
precommitted_evaluation.classification: Even positive here is deterministic one-step bounded public-information acquisition, NOT a learned active questioner, independent science, protected source custody or unattended recursive GPT research.
